settings.heading: HEAVY-DUTY PERFORMANCE. EVERYDAY VERSATILITY.
settings.text: Built for 2" receivers, this adjustable dual-ball hitch features a 6" drop/rise and two ball sizes to handle different towing needs. From daily hauling to demanding jobs, it's ready to get to work.

settings.heading: TWO BALL SIZES. MORE WAYS TO TOW
settings.text: Easily switch between 2" and 2-5/16" trailer balls to match different couplers without swapping hitches. Less hassle, fewer tools, and more flexibility for every towing job.

settings.heading: BUILT FOR STRENGTH, STABILITY & SECURITY
settings.text: Featuring durable steel construction, a corrosion-resistant coating, and locking hitch pins, this hitch is built for dependable performance wherever the road takes you.

settings.heading: BUILT FOR 2-INCH RECEIVER TRUCKS
settings.text: Designed for trucks with 2" receivers, this versatile hitch handles everything from equipment trailers to weekend adventures. One reliable setup for work, travel, and everyday towing.
